description: Fire a Dagster RunRequest when a Precisely Connect ETL job-run reaches terminal SUCCESS. Uses the documented Job Status endpoint only — sensor-only because Precisely does not publish submit / list-runs endpoints.

job_run_id.label: Job Run ID
job_run_id.description: Precisely Connect ETL job-run ID to watch (the only REST surface we can reliably hit).

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Dagster job to trigger when Precisely run reaches terminal SUCCESS

host_env_var.label: Host Env Var
host_env_var.description: Env var with Precisely Connect host URL

api_token_env_var.label: Api Token Env Var
api_token_env_var.description: Env var with Precisely API token

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Optional Dagster asset key. When set, the sensor also emits AssetMaterialization (or AssetObservation — see asset_event_type) for this key on terminal SUCCESS — which lights up the matching external_precisely_job asset in the catalog. Use '/' separators for nested keys, e.g. 'precisely/etl/load_customers'.

asset_event_type.label: Asset Event Type
asset_event_type.description: What kind of asset event to emit on terminal SUCCESS: 'materialization' (default — lights up the materialization history, what you want for jobs Dagster doesn't run itself) or 'observation' (emits AssetObservation instead — better when you want the materialization timeline reserved for assets Dagster materializes itself, and Precisely runs to be observability data alongside).

emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.
emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization

name: Precisely Job Sensor
